sentences.en: And this is a lie, but it's designed to get them out of the cell in a mood of hope.
sentences.zh: 这是一个谎言，但其目的是让他们怀着希望离开牢房。

sentences.en: But as the family are being ushered out, his daughter, the princess royale, bursts into floods of tears, hugs her father, collapses in a dead faint.
sentences.zh: 但当家人们被请出去时，他的女儿罗亚尔公主突然痛哭失流，拥抱她的父亲，彻底昏厥过去。

sentences.en: And the family will gather around, bring her back.
sentences.zh: 家人们围拢过来，把她救醒。

sentences.en: And this is the last time that they spend time together.
sentences.zh: 这是他们最后一次聚在一起。

sentences.en: And she's a teenager, isn't she?
sentences.zh: 她还是个十几岁的孩子，对吧？

sentences.en: She's what, 15 or so?
sentences.zh: 她大概15岁左右？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So that's that.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: That's the last time that they are together.
sentences.zh: 那是他们最后一次聚在一起。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the king is not the only person who has been hanging out with a priest because someone else has been receiving absolution.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，国王并不是唯一一个跟神父厮混的人，因为还有人正在接受赦免。

sentences.en: And this is someone that we mentioned in our last series.
sentences.zh: 这个人我们在上一季中提到过。

sentences.en: It's the man who will be operating the guillotine and executing the king the next morning.
sentences.zh: 他就是第二天将负责操作断头台并处决国王的人。

sentences.en: And this is Henri Sanson, the man who had been the royal executioner and who is, I guess,
sentences.zh: 他就是亨利·桑松，曾担任皇家刽子手的人，我想，

sentences.en: a kind of living link between the Ancien Régime and the new world that the revolution has ushered in.
sentences.zh: 他可以说是旧制度与革命开创新世界之间的一种活生生的纽带。

sentences.en: Because he's part of a, he's the sixth generation, I think, of Sansons who've been executioners, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 因为他是桑松家族的第六代刽子手，我没记错吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we did an episode on how all the kind of the weirdness surrounding executions and indeed the role of the executioner had been systematically got rid of by the Republican legislators.
sentences.zh: 我们曾做过一期节目，讲述共和派立法者如何系统地废除了所有围绕处决的诡异习俗以及刽子手的角色。

sentences.en: So Sanson, who had been the sinister figure in scarlet robes, who could just walk through marketplaces and grab whatever he wanted and wasn't allowed to go to theatres and things.
sentences.zh: 所以桑松，他曾是一个身穿猩红色长袍的阴险人物，可以在集市上横着走，随便拿自己想要的东西，还不准去剧院之类的地方。

sentences.en: He's now a state functionary and the emphasis is on the rational, the mechanical, the everyday.
sentences.zh: 他现在是一名国家公务员，强调的是理性、机械和日常化。

sentences.en: And so it's been decided that the king will be executed like any other criminal now in France by the guillotine.
sentences.zh: 因此决定像法国现在的任何其他罪犯一样，用断头台处决国王。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And because they want a stage suitable for the execution of a former king, they fix on the largest open square in the whole of Paris,
sentences.zh: 因为他们需要一个适合处决前国王的舞台，他们选中了整个巴黎最大的露天广场，

sentences.en: which is what today is the Place de la Concorde, but had originally been the Place Louis-Cainz, Louis XV.
sentences.zh: 也就是今天的协和广场，但最初是路易十五广场。

sentences.en: So there'd been a huge statue of Louis XV on a pedestal that had been removed back in August 1792.
sentences.zh: 广场底座上曾有一尊巨大的路易十五铜像，已于1792年8月被移走。

sentences.en: So the pedestal is now empty and actually in due course, a large statue of liberty will be set up on it.
sentences.zh: 所以底座现在空着，事实上不久之后，一尊巨大的自由女神像将竖立在上面。

sentences.en: It's also next to the Tuileries.
sentences.zh: 它也毗邻杜伊勒里宫。

sentences.en: So there's a kind of symbolic resonance there as well, because the Tuileries is seen as, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以这里也有某种象征性的共鸣，因为杜伊勒里宫被视为，你知道的，

sentences.en: this place where the blood of citizens had been spilled on the orders of the tyrant.
sentences.zh: 这个暴君下令流淌公民鲜血的地方。

sentences.en: So it's fitting that he'd be put to death within eyesight of it.
sentences.zh: 因此，在他的眼皮底下将他处决是很合适的。

sentences.en: And the Place Louis-Cainz has been renamed the Place de la Révolution.
sentences.zh: 路易十五广场已更名为革命广场。

sentences.en: Symbolically, it works on pretty much every level.
sentences.zh: 从象征意义上讲，它在各个层面都说得通。

sentences.en: And so the guillotine is brought there.
sentences.zh: 于是，断头台被运到了那里。

sentences.en: It's set up in the middle of it.
sentences.zh: 它被架设在广场的正中央。

sentences.en: And Sanson, you know, he checks the hinges.
sentences.zh: 桑松，你知道的，他检查了各个铰链。

sentences.en: He gets out the oil, makes sure the blade is properly weighted, sharpens it.
sentences.zh: 他拿出润滑油，确保刀片重量平衡，并将其磨锋利。

sentences.en: And the whole point is the death is something kind of Republican, something progressive.
sentences.zh: 这一切的核心意义在于，这种死亡带有一种共和的、进步的意味。

sentences.en: Clean and modern.
sentences.zh: 干净而现代。

sentences.en: Clean and modern.
sentences.zh: 干净而现代。

sentences.en: So not appropriate to the dispatch, not just of a king, but of monarchy itself.
sentences.zh: 因此，这不仅不适合发落一个国王，甚至不适合用来发落君主制本身。

sentences.en: So the day dawns and massive preparations have been made.
sentences.zh: 于是黎明破晓，大规模的准备工作已经就绪。

sentences.en: So armed men, soldiers, members of the National Guard have been ordered to line the entire route from the temple to the Place de la Révolution
sentences.zh: 全副武装的人员、士兵、国民自卫队成员接到命令，从圣殿到革命广场沿途列队站岗，

sentences.en: to make sure that the crowds are kept back.
sentences.zh: 确保将人群隔离在外。

sentences.en: And more importantly, that royalists can't kind of try and make an attempt to rescue the king or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，防止保皇党人试图营救国王或进行类似活动。

sentences.en: Again, this is very Charles I in Whitehall, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这跟当年查理一世在白厅的场景如出一辙，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely the same scenario.
sentences.zh: 完全是一样的剧本。

sentences.en: One thing that isn't like Charles I, though, where members of the General Republic were allowed to watch the execution, in the Place de la Révolution, it's only soldiers.
sentences.zh: 不过，与查理一世受刑时普通共和民众被允许围观不同，在革命广场，这里只有士兵。

sentences.en: So there are only armed men, about 80,000 of them.
sentences.zh: 所以只有武装人员，大约有八万名。

sentences.en: There are 84 pieces of artillery.
sentences.zh: 现场有84门火炮。

sentences.en: So the people there, they're armed and they're complete revolutionaries.
sentences.zh: 因此在场的人，他们全副武装且是不折不扣的革命者。

sentences.en: They're complete Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他们是不折不扣的共和派。

sentences.en: There's no doubt about that.
sentences.zh: 这一点毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: If the guillotine doesn't work, they can turn their cannons on him.
sentences.zh: 如果断头台出了问题，他们就可以把大炮对准他。

sentences.en: So, exactly, blast them to pieces.
sentences.zh: 没错，直接把他们轰成碎渣。

sentences.en: So orders are issued that anyone who cries out for the king to be pardoned or who gives any manifestation of royalist sympathy at all will be arrested and imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 因此当局下达命令，任何高呼赦免国王或表现出丝毫保皇党同情心的人，都将被逮捕并监禁。

sentences.en: Because the delegates to the convention, they're worried about the natural compassion of the feminine.
sentences.zh: 因为国民公会的代表们担心女性天生的同情心。

sentences.en: They're worried that women are more prone to displays of sympathy than men.
sentences.zh: 他们担心女性比男性更容易表露出同情。

sentences.en: A decree is ordered that all women should stay in their homes.
sentences.zh: 一条法令随即下达，要求所有女性待在家中。

sentences.en: They're not allowed out to watch the display and execution.
sentences.zh: 她们不被允许外出观看游行和处决。

sentences.en: All houses are ordered to be shuttered.
sentences.zh: 所有房屋都被勒令关紧百叶窗。

sentences.en: So, again, people can't lean out and kind of watch the passing display.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，人们同样无法探出头去观看路过的队伍。

sentences.en: And the mayor of Paris has a very stentorian notice plastered across the walls of the city so that everyone can read it.
sentences.zh: 巴黎市长在全城各处的墙上贴出了一份语气极其严厉的告示，好让所有人都能读到。

sentences.en: The sword of the law, this notice declares, will strike the greatest and the guiltiest of conspirators.
sentences.zh: 告示声称，法律之剑将打击最大、罪孽最深重的阴谋家。

sentences.en: You have, citizens of Paris, during the course of this long trial, maintained the calm that is suitable for free men.
sentences.zh: 巴黎的公民们，在这个漫长的审判过程中，你们一直保持着自由人应有的平静。

sentences.en: You will know how to preserve it at the instant of the execution of the tyrant.
sentences.zh: 你们也将在处决暴君的那一刻保持这份平静。

sentences.en: You will prove, by the decorum of your behaviour, that an act of justice in no way resembles vengeance.
sentences.zh: 你们将通过得体的行为向世人证明，正义之举绝不等同于复仇。

sentences.en: That day will be, for kings and for peoples, at once a memorable example of the just punishment of despots
sentences.zh: 对于国王和人民而言，那一天既将成为对暴君公正惩罚的难忘典范，

sentences.en: and of the mournful dignity that a sovereign people must keep in the exercise of its power.
sentences.zh: 也将彰显主权人民在行使权力时必须保持的庄严尊严。

sentences.en: And the thing is, people in the revolution just cannot stop talking like that.
sentences.zh: 关键是，大革命时期的人们就是改不了这种说话腔调。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All speeches, all public proclamations, they all sound like they've been lifted from, you know, a school book of Latin prose.
sentences.zh: 所有的演讲、所有的公开宣言，听起来都像是从拉丁文散文教材里抄出来的。

sentences.en: Yeah, they do, don't they?
sentences.zh: 确实如此，不是吗？

sentences.en: Well, they're doing it deliberately.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们是刻意这么做的。

sentences.en: That's how they think a revolutionary should write.
sentences.zh: 他们认为革命者就该这样写作。

sentences.en: So, early hours of the morning, the streets of Paris are sounding to the rumble of the artillery being taken into the Lasse de la Révolution.
sentences.zh: 因此，在清晨时分，巴黎的街道上回响着火炮被运往革命广场的轰鸣声。

sentences.en: You hear the clopping of hooves of the cavalry riding to take up place, the tread of soldiers taking up their positions.
sentences.zh: 你能听到骑兵赶赴指定位置的阵阵马蹄声，以及士兵们就位时的铿锵步伐。

sentences.en: 5 a.m., Sanson, the executioner, is wakened by his assistant so that he can go again, you know, check all the mechanics and everything.
sentences.zh: 早上5点，刽子手桑松被助手叫醒，以便他能再次去检查所有的机械装置等等。

sentences.en: He doesn't want it to go wrong.
sentences.zh: 他可不想出任何差错。

sentences.en: And at the same time in the temple, 5 o'clock, Louis is wakened by Clary, his valet, who shaves them.
sentences.zh: 与此同时在圣殿，5点整，路易被他的贴身男仆克拉里叫醒并为他刮脸。

sentences.en: 6 a.m., Louis' last confession with the Abbé de Firmont, his confessor.
sentences.zh: 早晨6点，路易与其忏悔神父菲尔蒙神父进行最后的忏悔。

sentences.en: He has not eaten the night before.
sentences.zh: 他前一晚没有吃东西。

sentences.en: He doesn't eat now because the last rites are accompanied by fasting.
sentences.zh: 他现在也不吃，因为临终圣事需要伴随着禁食。

sentences.en: 7 a.m., he is dressed by Clary.
sentences.zh: 早上7点，克拉里为他穿好衣服。

sentences.en: He wears, we're told, a fresh shirt, a white waistcoat, grey trousers, a light jacket.
sentences.zh: 据说他穿了一件崭新的衬衫、一件白色马甲、一条灰色裤子和一件浅色夹克。

sentences.en: And Louis takes off his wedding ring to be given to Marie Antoinette.
sentences.zh: 路易摘下结婚戒指，打算交给玛丽·安托瓦内特。

sentences.en: And he has a royal seal, which he's taken from his watch.
sentences.zh: 他还带着一枚从怀表上取下来的皇家印章。

sentences.en: So that hadn't been confiscated.
sentences.zh: 这枚印章没有被没收。

sentences.en: And this is to be given to his son.
sentences.zh: 这是要留给他儿子的。

sentences.en: And his son, of course, before the morning is out, will become, if you are a royalist, Louis XVII.
sentences.zh: 当然，在今天结束之前，如果你是个保皇党，他的儿子将成为路易十七。

sentences.en: 7.45, a delegation from the city of Paris arrives.
sentences.zh: 7点45分，来自巴黎市的代表团抵达。

sentences.en: They are accompanied by 14 soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他们由14名士兵陪同。

sentences.en: They stand to attention in two rows outside Louis' cell.
sentences.zh: 他们在路易的囚室外排成两行立正站好。

sentences.en: Louis asks for permission for Clary to cut his hair at the nape of his neck because he doesn't want the humiliation of having Sanson, the executioner, do it.
sentences.zh: 路易请求允许让克拉里修剪他脖颈后方的头发，因为他不想承受由刽子手桑松来做这件事的羞辱。

sentences.en: Which is something, of course, that Sanson has done many, many times over the course of his career.
sentences.zh: 当然，在桑松的职业生涯中，这已经是他做过无数次的事情了。

sentences.en: But this is denied him.
sentences.zh: 但这个请求被拒绝了。

sentences.en: He is a common criminal.
sentences.zh: 他是一名普通罪犯。

sentences.en: He is going to be treated like a common criminal.
sentences.zh: 他将受到普通罪犯般的对待。

sentences.en: Louis then kneels down.
sentences.zh: 随后路易跪了下来。

sentences.en: He's blessed by the Abbé.
sentences.zh: 神父为他祝福。

sentences.en: They then stand around.
sentences.zh: 接着他们站在原地。

sentences.en: It's a bit of embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 场面有些尴尬。

sentences.en: Nobody's quite sure what to do.
sentences.zh: 谁也不太确定该做些什么。

sentences.en: So Louis then says, partons, you know, let's head off.
sentences.zh: 于是路易开口说道：“走吧，我们出发吧。”

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: “我们走。”

sentences.en: They go outside.
sentences.zh: 他们走了出去。

sentences.en: It's very cold.
sentences.zh: 天气非常冷。

sentences.en: There's a fog everywhere, so hard to see through the gloom.
sentences.zh: 到处都是大雾，昏暗得很难看清路。

sentences.en: Out in the streets, piles of snow so that people can get by along the road.
sentences.zh: 街上堆着积雪，人们只能沿路艰难通行。

sentences.en: I said that Louis is to be treated like a common criminal.
sentences.zh: 我刚才说路易将被当作普通罪犯对待。

sentences.en: There is one exception to this, and that is that he is given a coach.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个例外，那就是他获得了一辆马车。

sentences.en: So he's not put in the tumbril in the open cart.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有被关在露天的囚车里。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is basically security.
sentences.zh: 之所以这么做，主要是出于安全考虑。

sentences.en: If he's in the coach, it's much easier to guard him.
sentences.zh: 如果他在马车里，守卫起来要容易得多。

sentences.en: And the coach has been provided by Gara, the Minister of Justice.
sentences.zh: 这辆马车是由司法部长加拉提供的。

sentences.en: It's a great bottle green thing, although not as large as the coach that...
sentences.zh: 那是一辆巨大的瓶绿色马车，不过没有……

sentences.en: Not the Varen super coach.
sentences.zh: 不是瓦雷讷那种超级马车。

sentences.en: The Varen, the Varen wasp-like coach that they take into Varen.
sentences.zh: 不是瓦雷讷那种黄蜂般的马车，他们曾乘那辆车去过瓦雷讷。

sentences.en: So Louis gets into the coach.
sentences.zh: 于是路易上了马车。

sentences.en: There are two members of the security services, I suppose you could say, sitting on either side.
sentences.zh: 我想可以说有两名安全部门的人员坐在他的两侧。

sentences.en: The abbé sits at the front, and the whole way there, Louis is murmuring the prayer of the dying over and over to himself.
sentences.zh: 神父坐在前面，一路之上，路易一直在心里反反复复地默念着临终祷告。

sentences.en: Otherwise, he doesn't say anything.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他一言不发。

sentences.en: And as they set off, there are a hundred mounted police behind it, a hundred mounted members of the National Guard.
sentences.zh: 当他们出发时，后面跟着一百名骑警，以及一百名骑马的国民自卫队员。

sentences.en: So the rumbling of the wheels, the clopping of the horses, generally silence from the watching crowds who are massed behind the lines of the guards along the route.
sentences.zh: 车轮的隆隆声，马蹄的得得声，而沿途排成防线后方黑压压的围观群众则是一片死寂。

sentences.en: They set off at eight o'clock, and it takes them two hours to get there.
sentences.zh: 他们在八点钟出发，花了两个小时才到达目的地。

sentences.en: And in the course of those two hours, there are two royalist attempts to reach Louis.
sentences.zh: 在那两个小时里，保皇党人曾有过两次试图接近路易的尝试。

sentences.en: They're both easily subdued, easily stopped.
sentences.zh: 这两次都被轻易平息、轻易阻止了。

sentences.en: And at ten o'clock, the carriage arrives in the Place de la Révolution, and it stands still for five minutes.
sentences.zh: 十点钟，马车抵达革命广场，并在那里停了五分钟。

sentences.en: And then Sanson's assistant steps up to it, opens up the door, the steps are pulled down, and Louis is seized by Sanson and his assistants.
sentences.zh: 随后，桑松的助手走上前打开车门，放下了脚踏板，路易被桑松和助手们强行拉了下来。

sentences.en: When they touch him, Louis loses his sense of composure, because we've talked about that sense that the king's body is inviolate, how dare people manhandle him.
sentences.zh: 当他们触碰他时，路易失去了克制，因为我们之前谈到过那种国王神圣不可侵犯的观念，这些人怎么敢对他动手动脚。

sentences.en: But then he catches the eye of his confessor, of the abbé, and the abbé kind of says, you know, don't do this.
sentences.zh: 但接着他捕捉到了忏悔神父也就是神父的目光，神父似乎在说，你知道的，别这样。

sentences.en: This is, you don't need to do this.
sentences.zh: 这，你没必要这样做。

sentences.en: And clearly they've talked about the passion of Christ, and essentially Louis is thinking, well, his saviour suffered worse.
sentences.zh: 显然他们讨论过基督的受难，本质上路易在想，他的救世主遭受了更痛苦的折磨。

sentences.en: So he accepts to be handled by the executioners.
sentences.zh: 因此他接受了被刽子手们摆布。

sentences.en: So he then, he takes off his coat, and he pulls down his shirt, so that his neck is open.
sentences.zh: 于是他脱下外套，拉下衬衫，好让脖子露出来。

sentences.en: His wrists are bound behind his back.
sentences.zh: 他的手腕在背后被绑了起来。

sentences.en: His wig is taken off, and then Sanson comes with the shears, with the clippers, and his hair is cut, so that the nape of his neck is exposed.
sentences.zh: 他的假发被取下，接着桑松拿着大剪刀和修剪器走过来，剪短了他的头发，暴露出他的脖颈。

sentences.en: He climbs up to the guillotine.
sentences.zh: 他爬上了断头台。

sentences.en: He has to lean on the abbé, because he's got his hands behind his back, so a bit unstable.
sentences.zh: 他不得不依靠神父搀扶，因为他的双手被绑在身后，身体有些不稳。

sentences.en: And when he gets onto the scaffold, he tries to address the crowd, and he seems to have uttered a few sentences.
sentences.zh: 当他登上刑台时，他试图向人群讲话，似乎还说出了几句话。

sentences.en: So according to various accounts, he says, people, I die innocent of the crimes that they ascribe to me.
sentences.zh: 根据各种记载，他说：“民众啊，我对于强加给我的罪行是无辜的。”

sentences.en: I forgive the authors of my death, and I pray to God that the blood you are about to spill will never fall back upon France.
sentences.zh: “我宽恕我的死敌，并祈求上帝，愿你们即将流下的鲜血永远不要降临到法国头上。”

sentences.en: And at this point, there is a great drum roll.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一阵激昂的鼓点响起。

sentences.en: The captain of the guard has been prepared to do this, should Louis try to make a public speech.
sentences.zh: 卫队队长已经做好了准备，以防路易试图发表公开演讲。

sentences.en: And so Louis' voice is drowned out.
sentences.zh: 于是路易的声音被淹没了。

sentences.en: As the drums are rolling, Sanson's assistants get hold of Louis.
sentences.zh: 伴随着阵阵鼓声，桑松的助手们抓住了路易。

sentences.en: They strap him down onto the board, and they push him out so that his head is protruding, ready for the blade to cut through the neck.
sentences.zh: 他们把他绑在木板上，然后把他推向前，使他的头部凸显出来，准备让刀刃切过脖子。

sentences.en: It's Sanson himself who pulls on the cord.
sentences.zh: 是桑松本人拉动了绳索。

sentences.en: The blade hisses down, cuts straight through Louis' neck, and the head drops into the basket.
sentences.zh: 刀刃呼啸而下，直接切断了路易的脖子，头颅落入了篮子里。

sentences.en: And it is 10.22 a.m.
sentences.zh: 当时是上午10点22分。

sentences.en: Sanson then does what he'd do with any beheaded criminal.
sentences.zh: 随后，桑松做着他对任何被斩首的罪犯都会做的事。

sentences.en: He picks up the head, and he shows it to the crowd.
sentences.zh: 他捡起人头，向人群展示。

sentences.en: And the people roar back in answer, vive la nation, vive la république.
sentences.zh: 人群齐声高呼回应：“法兰西万岁，共和国万岁。”

sentences.en: There is then the sound of gunfire, of artillery to mark the moment.
sentences.zh: 接着传出了枪声和炮声，以标示这个时刻。

sentences.en: And in the distant temple, Marie Antoinette hears it.
sentences.zh: 在远处的圣殿里，玛丽·安托瓦内特听到了声音。

sentences.en: She knows what it signals.
sentences.zh: 她明白这意味着什么。

sentences.en: And she drops to her knees before her son, who a few minutes before had been the Dauphin.
sentences.zh: 她双膝跪倒在她的儿子面前，而在几分钟前，他还是王太子。

sentences.en: And now, in the opinion of Marie Antoinette and all royalists in France, is Louis XVII.
sentences.zh: 而现在，在玛丽·安托瓦内特和法国所有保皇党人看来，他就是路易十七。

sentences.en: Crikey.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: What a moment.
sentences.zh: 真是个历史性的时刻。

sentences.en: So you mentioned the crowd.
sentences.zh: 所以你提到了人群。

sentences.en: The crowd, of course, are mainly troops, because the ordinary people of Paris have been kept away from this moment.
sentences.zh: 当然，人群主要是军队，因为巴黎的普通百姓被隔离在这个时刻之外。

sentences.en: But within a couple of hours of this, am I not right in thinking that the troops have moved away, people come into the streets?
sentences.zh: 但在这一切发生后的短短几个小时内，我是不是没记错的话，军队已经撤离，人们走上街头了？

sentences.en: It's a little bit like on a public holiday.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是在过公众假日。

sentences.en: People are strolling around, and, you know, I know it's January, so it's not exactly that they're enjoying the sunshine.
sentences.zh: 人们四处闲逛，而且，我知道当时是一月，所以他们倒也不是在享受阳光。

sentences.en: But people are acting as though it's just an ordinary Sunday or something, sort of taking the air as though nothing has happened.
sentences.zh: 但人们的表现就像是在过一个普通的星期天一样，仿佛什么都没发生过似地出来散步。

sentences.en: So Marat, a couple of days later, he describes the public mood on that day, in the hours that follow Louis' execution.
sentences.zh: 因此马拉在几天后描述了那一天的公众情绪，在路易被处决后的几个小时里。

sentences.en: And he says that the people seemed animated with a serene joy.
sentences.zh: 他说人们脸上流露着一种宁静的喜悦。

sentences.en: One might have said that they had just attended a religious festival.
sentences.zh: 人们可能会说他们刚刚参加完一个宗教节日。

sentences.en: And he might well have put it like that, because essentially, you know, and Marat is very conscious of this, what has been staged is a kind of ritual of sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 他完全可以这样表达，因为本质上，你知道的——马拉对此有着清醒的认识——被精心策划上演的是一种献祭仪式。

sentences.en: And it's a sacrifice that has enabled the Republic to be born in a way that it had not previously been born.
sentences.zh: 正是这种献祭，让共和国得以诞生，以一种此前从未有过的方式诞生。

sentences.en: So Marat, in the article he wrote on the 23rd, so two days after the execution, he goes on to say,
sentences.zh: 因此马拉在他于23日（即处决后两天）发表的文章中继续写道：

sentences.en: The head of the tyrant has just fallen.
sentences.zh: “暴君的头颅刚刚落地。”

sentences.en: The same blow has overthrown the foundations of monarchy among us.
sentences.zh: “同样的打击已经推翻了我们中间君主制的基石。”

sentences.en: His life is no more.
sentences.zh: “他的生命已不复存在。”

sentences.en: His body is now nothing but a corpse.
sentences.zh: “他的身体现在只是一具尸体。”

sentences.en: At last, I believe in the Republic.
sentences.zh: “我终于相信共和国的存在了。”

sentences.en: So amazing, the Marat of all people.
sentences.zh: 这真是太惊人了，竟然是马拉说出这样的话。

sentences.en: This is what it has taken for him to believe that the Republic exists at laSt.
sentences.zh: 他竟然需要经历这一切，才终于相信共和国真的存在了。

sentences.en: And there's a massive paradox here, because Louis did have to die as a king for the Republic to be born,
sentences.zh: 这里面有一个巨大的悖论，因为路易必须作为国王死去，共和国才能诞生，

sentences.en: because otherwise the sacrifice wouldn't have had the quality that it does have.
sentences.zh: 因为否则这种牺牲就不会具备它所拥有的那种特殊分量。

sentences.en: But the moment he's dead and the Republic has been given existence, then his body has to be treated as though he had been nothing,
sentences.zh: 但就在他死后、共和国获得生存的那一刻起，他的尸体却必须被当成他什么都不是一样来对待，

sentences.en: as though he's just an ordinary citizen convicted of a crime.
sentences.zh: 就好像他只是一个因犯罪而被定罪的普通公民一样。

sentences.en: Nothing more, nothing less.
sentences.zh: 不多也不少。

sentences.en: No kind of special treatment in any way.
sentences.zh: 没有任何形式的特殊待遇。

sentences.en: So certainly Louis' body is not allowed to be buried in the royal catacombs or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 因此，路易的遗体当然绝不允许被埋葬在皇家地下墓穴或类似的地方。

sentences.en: There had been a request before the execution from royalists for him to be buried next to his father.
sentences.zh: 在行刑前，保王党曾提出请求，希望将他埋葬在他父亲的旁边。

sentences.en: That had been denied.
sentences.zh: 这一请求被拒绝了。

sentences.en: But at the same time, no special kind of desecration, no humiliations perpetrated on the corpse.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，也没有对遗体进行任何特殊的亵渎或羞辱。

sentences.en: Instead, he has to be buried, that the convention has decreed, in the ordinary place of burial for citizens in the section that includes where he will be executed.
sentences.zh: 相反，国民公会已经下令，他必须被埋葬在公民的普通墓地里，就在他将被处决的那片区域内。

sentences.en: That's what they've said.
sentences.zh: 他们就是这么说的。

sentences.en: So just as though he's any other condemned criminal.
sentences.zh: 所以，就和任何其他被判刑的罪犯一样。

sentences.en: So he gets taken to the church that serves as the burial ground for executed criminals.
sentences.zh: 因此，他被带到了那座专门用来安葬被处决罪犯的教堂。

sentences.en: His funeral service is conducted not by the abbé, who had been his confessor, but by a priest who is acceptable to the Republic, to the revolutionaries.
sentences.zh: 他的葬礼不是由曾担任他忏悔神父的修道院院长主持的，而是由一位共和国和革命者能够接受的牧师主持的。

sentences.en: His body is then thrown into a ditch on a bed of quicklime, which will help it become kind of mulch.
sentences.zh: 接着，他的尸体被扔进了一条沟里的生石灰床上，这会帮助它腐烂分解。

sentences.en: The head is tossed in as well, and then it's covered by more quicklime.
sentences.zh: 头颅也被扔了进去，然后上面盖上了更多的生石灰。

sentences.en: So this is a communal grave.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个乱葬岗。

sentences.en: There is to be no marker.
sentences.zh: 这里不会有任何墓碑。

sentences.en: Instead, it is left mingled up with other corpses where it will decompose.
sentences.zh: 相反，它被与其他尸体混在一起，任由其腐烂。

sentences.en: The whole thing, it's no special treatment whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 总之，这没有任何一点特殊待遇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's the intention.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的目的。

sentences.en: But of course, in the long run, it turns out neither side really content with this spin on the execution of Louis or the fate of his body.
sentences.zh: 但当然，从长远来看，事实证明双方对路易处决的这种处理方式以及他尸体的命运都不真正满意。

sentences.en: And so for royalists, obviously, this is a terrible crime.
sentences.zh: 因此，对保王党来说，这显然是一场可怕的罪行。

sentences.en: And as had happened with Charles I, so with Louis XVI, it doesn't take them long before they are comparing Louis' fate to that of ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 正如查理一世当年那样，对于路易十六，他们没过多久就开始将路易的命运与基督相提并论。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A martyr.
sentences.zh: 一个殉道者。

sentences.en: He's a martyr.
sentences.zh: 他是一个殉道者。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's a Christian martyr.
sentences.zh: 对，他是一个基督教殉道者。

sentences.en: A martyr for monarchy, but above all, a martyr for the true church.
sentences.zh: 一个为了君主制而殉道的烈士，但最重要的是，一个为了真正教会而殉道的烈士。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But Republicans as well, and it may be that they are reacting to the kind of the royalist propaganda,
sentences.zh: 但共和派也是如此，他们可能也是在对保王党的这种宣传做出反应，

sentences.en: they find it impossible to rest content with the idea that Louis had died simply as a common criminal.
sentences.zh: 他们发现自己无法接受路易仅仅作为一个普通罪犯死去的想法。

sentences.en: So already within a week of Louis' execution, you get newspapers claiming that his death, rather than being what it had been, which was something wholly unexceptional,
sentences.zh: 因此，就在路易被处决后不到一周，报纸上就出现了这样的说法：他的死与其说是毫无例外、平平常常——

sentences.en: that had been the whole point, had actually been something shameful and disgraceful.
sentences.zh: 而这本来正是他们的本意——倒不如说是一件极其耻辱和丢脸的事。

sentences.en: So in one paper, you get an account.
sentences.zh: 所以在某份报纸上，你能看到这样的记述。

sentences.en: At the instant that speech was so brutally taken from him by a definite beating of drums,
sentences.zh: 就在那阵强烈的鼓声粗暴地夺走他说话的权利的那一瞬间，

sentences.en: Louis entered into a violent anger, stamped his foot, struggled with vigour with the executioner's assistance,
sentences.zh: 路易勃然大怒，重重地跺了跺脚，在刽子手的协助下拼死挣扎，

sentences.en: let out terrible cries, and fought to the end to such an extent that he had not his neck, but the back of his head and his jaw horribly mutilated by the fatal knife.
sentences.zh: 发出可怕的尖叫，并顽抗到了最后一刻，以至于那致命的刀刃砍的不是他的脖子，而是他后脑勺和下巴，被恐怖地残害了。

sentences.en: So this is a claim that is quite often made, that it took two goes of the guillotine to sever his neck.
sentences.zh: 所以这种说法相当普遍，称断头台切断他的脖子砍了两次。

sentences.en: Which is not true.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是真的。

sentences.en: And also there are reports that as he died, he let out a piercing.
sentences.zh: 而且还有报道称，当他死的时候，他发出了刺耳的——

sentences.en: Scream, again, not true.
sentences.zh: 尖叫，同样，这不是真的。

sentences.en: You know, his vocal cords have been severed.
sentences.zh: 你要知道，他的声带已经被割断了。

sentences.en: And there are also claims which supposedly derive from Sanson.
sentences.zh: 还有一些据称源自桑松的说法。

sentences.en: And Sanson, you know, they become so repeated that Sanson actually has to publicly reject them,
sentences.zh: 而且桑松，你知道的，这些传言被传得如此之多，以至于桑松不得不公开否认它们，

sentences.en: that on the night before his execution and the hours before he's taken to the guillotine,
sentences.zh: 说是就在他被处决的前夜以及被押上断头台前的几个小时里，

sentences.en: Louis had been stuffing his face.
sentences.zh: 路易一直在大吃大喝。

sentences.en: And this is to repeat the old child, you know, that he's the pig king.
sentences.zh: 这其实是在重复那个老掉牙的恶毒言论，你知道的，说他是猪猡国王。

sentences.en: And there are accounts that, you know, he'd been so fat that he hadn't fitted onto the board that, you know, that he's executed on.
sentences.zh: 还有人说，你知道的，他胖得甚至都塞不进他行刑时躺的那块木板上。

sentences.en: And then there's another one that he's, you know, the bulges and folds of his neck had been so obese that it wouldn't fit in the slot.
sentences.zh: 然后还有人说，你知道的，他脖子上的赘肉和褶皱太肥胖了，以至于塞不进那个卡槽里。

sentences.en: Again, not true.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，这不是真的。

sentences.en: I mean, simply not true.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，纯属无稽之谈。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because, of course, he'd been fasting because for religious reasons.
sentences.zh: 因为很显然，出于宗教原因，他一直在斋戒。

sentences.en: Yes, he had.
sentences.zh: 没错，他的确如此。

sentences.en: And so it's an attempt to kind of contradict that.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种试图反驳这种说法的行为。

sentences.en: And what it does, of course, is to ensure that Louis' execution, rather than providing, as it were,
sentences.zh: 而这样做的结果，当然就是确保了路易的处决——并没有像人们预期的那样，

sentences.en: a clear cut between the age of monarchy and the republic, and that the republic is now uncontested,
sentences.zh: 在君主制时代和共和国之间划清界限，并让共和国从此稳如磐石、不再受到质疑——

sentences.en: it's not uncontested at all, the way in which both royalists and republicans try and rewrite the story
sentences.zh: 它根本不是没有争议的，保王党和共和派试图重写路易被处决故事的方式，实际上对法国来说是个极不祥的征兆，

sentences.en: of Louis' execution actually bodes very ill for France, because it suggests that there are deep,
sentences.zh: 因为这表明对于所发生的事情，人们有着深刻、根深蒂固且立场坚定的意见，

sentences.en: entrenched, principled opinions about what has been done, that there isn't really any hope of reconciling them.
sentences.zh: 根本没有希望将它们调和起来。

sentences.en: And it suggests that even though perhaps the foreign threats to France have been beaten off, although who knows for how long, now that the king has been executed,
sentences.zh: 这也表明，尽管法国面临的外部威胁可能已经被击退，虽然不知道能维持多久，但既然国王已经被处决，

sentences.en: who knows what the international response to that will be.
sentences.zh: 谁知道国际社会对此会有什么反应呢。

sentences.en: But that may not be the worst of it, because it suggests that actually within the body of France itself, a civil war may be brewing.
sentences.zh: 但那可能还不是最糟糕的，因为它表明在法国本土内部，一场内战可能正在酝酿之中。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What a dramatic end to the third series on the French Revolution.
sentences.zh: 法国大革命第三季迎来了多么戏剧性的结局啊。

sentences.en: Season three has come to an end with the execution of Louis XVI, but many of the big players are still around and in play.
sentences.zh: 随着路易十六的处决，第三季落下了帷幕，但许多核心大人物依然活跃在历史的舞台上。

sentences.en: Marie Antoinette, Rob Speer, Danton, Marat, in season four, which will be coming later this year, we will find out what happens to all of those characters.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·安托瓦内特、罗伯斯庇尔、丹东、马拉，在将于今年晚些时候推出的第四季中，我们将知晓所有这些角色的命运。

sentences.en: A little spoiler alert for you, none of them will make it.
sentences.zh: 剧透一下，他们当中没有一个人能活到最后。

sentences.en: Well, they definitely won't be around in season six or seven, will they?
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们肯定不会出现在第六季或第七季里，对吧？

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: So there's an awful lot of drama, a lot of bloodshed to come.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来还有相当多的戏剧性和血腥事件要上演。

sentences.en: No doubt in our forthcoming bonus episodes for the Manchester's History Club members, we'll be talking about some of the issues that have come up in this series.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，在我们即将为曼彻斯特历史俱乐部会员推出的独家加更节目中，我们将讨论本季中出现的一些议题。

sentences.en: But thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 但感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: We will return to the French Revolution later in the year.
sentences.zh: 我们将在今年晚些时候回归法国大革命的主题。

sentences.en: Tom, merci beaucoup et au revoir.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，非常感谢，再见。

sentences.en: Au revoir.
sentences.zh: 再见。
